The XYZ Doohickey Company was founded in 1971, and has been providing quality doohickeys to the public ever since. Located in Gotham City, XYZ employs over 2,000 people and does all kinds of awesome things for the Gotham community.

The Marketing course completely changed how I work. Lessons are clear, exercises are meaningful, and instructors actually respond quickly, supportively, and with helpful feedback.

We will help you in every step.
How do I enroll in a course?
Browse the course catalogue, click Enroll on any course page, and complete checkout. Your course will appear in your dashboard immediately.
How long does a typical course take?
Yes, every course comes with a 14-day no-questions-asked refund policy. Just reach out to support and we’ll process it right away.
Absolutely. Every course includes a dedicated discussion forum where instructors and fellow students actively engage, share projects, and give feedback.
Are there live classes or just recorded content?
Both. All courses include on-demand video lessons you can watch anytime, plus monthly live Q&A sessions with instructors for All-Access members.
Do I get a certificate when I finish?
Yes. Every completed course earns you a signed, shareable certificate of completion that you can add directly to your LinkedIn profile.

slots.text: Built by teachers who were tired of clunky course tools

Online LMS started in 2019 as an internal tool for a small group of instructors who wanted a calmer way to publish structured lessons. Today more than 40,000 learners study here every month, across 820+ courses in design, development, marketing, finance and data.
We have stayed deliberately small in scope: publish a course, learn a course, track progress. Everything else is optional.
✓ Course authoring that takes minutes, not weekends
✓ Certificates recognized by our partner companies
✓ Human support, seven days a week
